campaigns.emptyHint: Connect a TikTok or Meta ad account, then sync.

help.title: How WOB knows which ad a chat came from
help.meta: Click-to-WhatsApp ads attach the ad automatically. For ads that open your website first, have your page add fbclid=<click id> from the page address to the prefilled message.
help.tiktok: TikTok doesn't pass the click to WhatsApp. Use the link below as your ad's website URL: it's a real web page (so the pixel works) that opens WhatsApp with the click ID and campaign in the message.
help.noNumber: Connect a WhatsApp number first to get your ad link.
help.defaultText: Hi, I'd like to know more
help.verify: After launching, send yourself one test click and check the lead shows TikTok as its source. The WhatsApp message should end with ttclid=… and cid=… followed by real values. Don't remove that part of the message.

campaigns.metaSpendHint: Meta campaign names and spend need the optional read-only token. Add it in Connections → Meta to see cost per qualified lead and per client for Meta.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Scan a QR code with the phone you take orders on. You keep chatting from that phone as usual.

tiktok.title: TikTok Ads
tiktok.description: Lets WOB read your campaign spend and send qualified leads and clients back to TikTok.
tiktok.chooseHint: Your TikTok login opens several ad accounts. Each business in WOB uses one. Pick the one for this business; the others are removed from it (nothing changes in TikTok).
tiktok.kept: Ad account saved for this business
tiktok.disconnectBody: WOB stops reading this ad account and stops sending events to TikTok until you connect it again. Your campaign history and pixel stay. To refresh permissions without a gap, use Reconnect instead.
tiktok.disconnectFailed: Could not disconnect the ad account
tiktok.settingUp: Setting up tracking on your ad account…
tiktok.noTracking: Tracking is not set up yet.
tiktok.pixelHint: From TikTok Events Manager. Qualified leads and clients are reported through this pixel.
tiktok.testPrompt: Paste the Test Event Code from TikTok Events Manager (Pixel → Test Events). Leave empty to send a live event.

meta.title: Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram)
meta.description: Sends qualified leads and clients to your Meta pixel so Meta optimizes for buyers. No Facebook login needed.

help.step1: Open Meta Events Manager and choose your pixel.
help.step2: Go to Settings → Conversions API → Generate access token.
help.step3: Paste the Pixel ID and the token here. The token is stored securely and is never shown again.

meta.pixelRequired: Enter the pixel ID and the access token
meta.testPrompt: Paste the Test Event Code from Meta Events Manager (Test events tab). Leave empty to send a live event.
meta.adsHint: Add a read-only token to see Meta campaign names, spend, and cost per qualified lead and per client. Without it, events are still sent to your pixel but Meta spend stays blank.
meta.adsHelp: Create the token in Meta Business Settings → System users (permission: ads_read), or use any token that can read the ad account.
meta.adsRequired: Enter the ad account ID and the token
meta.confirmAdsDisconnect: Remove the ad account? Campaign names and spend will stop updating.
meta.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect Meta? WOB will stop sending events to your pixel.

ai.title: AI Agent
ai.subtitle: Optional add-on: let AI reply to new leads and follow up
ai.enableHint: Off by default. When on, AI answers new leads, asks your qualifying questions and hands the chat to you when needed.
ai.warning: QR-linked WhatsApp is not the official WhatsApp Business API. Automated messages, especially many follow-ups, can get a number restricted by WhatsApp. Keep follow-ups few and only during the day.

ai.followUpHint: Nudge leads who stopped replying. Never sent to people who said stop.
ai.hoursInvalid: The start hour must be before the end hour

sales.title: Sales message
sales.hint: Send this message to the customer every time they place an order. WOB reads it, counts a sale with the total, and reports the purchase to TikTok/Meta.
sales.template:
✅ {{marker}} #1234
Total: 45 USD
Thank you for your order!
sales.defaultHint: Used when your confirmation message has no Total, so TikTok/Meta still get a purchase value.
sales.defaultInvalid: Enter an amount above zero and a 3-letter currency, or leave both empty
sales.rule: Only messages you send that contain the key phrase count. Keep "Total: <amount> <currency>" so the order value is reported.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Your products, prices, photos and videos. The AI uses them to answer and sends the photos in WhatsApp.
catalog.emptyHint: Add your products so the AI can quote prices and send photos.
catalog.name: Product name
catalog.mediaHint: Images or videos up to {{mb}} MB each. The first photo is what the AI sends.

import.title: Import products from your website
import.hint: WOB reads the products, prices and photos from your online shop and adds them here. Products already in your catalog are not duplicated. Works with Shopify, WooCommerce and most shops that show their products to Google.
import.working: Reading your website and copying photos. This can take up to a minute.
import.nothingNew: All {{found}} products found were already in your catalog.
import.none_found: No products were found on that website. If the shop is built with a custom system, add the products by hand or send us the link.
import.bad_url: Enter a valid website address, for example myshop.com.
import.failed: The import did not work. Check the address and try again.

funding.title: Funding
funding.subtitle: Top up each client ad account from its own TikTok Business Center
funding.adminsOnly: Only agency owners and admins can fund ad accounts.
funding.connectHint: Log in with a TikTok user who has Finance Manager permission on your Business Centers. WOB uses each Business Center's own balance to top up its ad accounts; WOB never holds your money.
funding.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect your Business Center? You will not be able to fund accounts until you connect again.
funding.noAccounts: No ad accounts found under the Business Centers your login can fund.
funding.fundHint: The money moves from this ad account's own Business Center balance into the ad account.
funding.confirmLine: You are about to add {{amount}} to {{name}}.
funding.unknown: TikTok did not confirm. Check the account in TikTok before trying again.
funding.rawSample: Technical: raw account data from TikTok
funding.visibleBcs: Business Centers your TikTok login can see
funding.authorizedAds: Ad accounts shared with WOB by this login: {{count}}
funding.diagnoseHint: If an account appears under "shared" but not under "administers", TikTok only lets WOB top up accounts the Business Center has Admin access to. Give your Business Center admin permission on that ad account.
funding.balanceListLine: Ad accounts this Business Center administers (what Funding lists)
funding.assetsLine: Ad accounts shared with or owned by this Business Center
funding.noBcs: Your TikTok login does not administer any Business Center.
funding.noFinance: Your TikTok login has no Finance Manager role in this Business Center, so accounts here cannot be funded from WOB.
funding.bcEmpty: This Business Center has no available balance. Add funds in TikTok first.
funding.bcError: Could not load this Business Center: {{message}}
funding.reconnectHint: TikTok refused the request. Reconnect your Business Center and approve all the permissions it asks for.
funding.advertiserNotFound: Ad account {{id}} was not found under a Business Center your login can fund from. Check it is administered by one of your Business Centers and that your login is Finance Manager there.
funding.requestNoBc: Account not found under a Business Center you can finance.
funding.approveLine: Add {{amount}} to {{name}} from {{bc}}. The money leaves that Business Center balance now.
funding.firstLoad: Reading your Business Centers from TikTok for the first time. This can take up to a minute.
funding.syncFailed: Couldn't refresh balances from TikTok: {{message}}. Showing the last saved list.
funding.pickTitle: Choose the Business Centers to use
funding.pickHint: This TikTok login manages more than one Business Center. Pick the ones WOB should use for funding. You can change this later.
funding.noFinanceRole: No Finance Manager role: can't fund

balance.title: TikTok ad balance
balance.reconnect: WOB needs TikTok permission to read this balance.

level.empty: Balance is empty: your ads can't run until you add funds.
level.low: Balance is low: ads may stop soon.

balance.howTitle: Add funds to this ad account
balance.howBc: This ad account is paid through a Business Center. Funds are added there, by the Business Center admin (usually your agency).
balance.howDirect: TikTok takes the payment, so WOB sends you to TikTok to add funds.
balance.step1: Open TikTok Ads Manager with the login that owns this ad account.
balance.step2: Go to Tools → Billing (some versions call it Finance), choose Add balance and pick the amount.
balance.step2Bc: In TikTok Business Center, open Finance → Payment management and add funds to this ad account.
balance.step3: Come back here: WOB shows the new balance within a couple of minutes.
balance.delay: TikTok can take a few minutes to show the new balance.
